notes: Short 6-page arXiv preprint. Tables 1-3 report 'critical datapoints' from per-K curves (Figs. 10-12, not readable as text); the K (2,4,8,16,32) behind each pre-sorted value is never stated. Pre-sorted TMs were early-stopped when accuracy reached 100% on an inference between epochs, which Sec. 6 calls the test accuracy, and the training time is the faster of two strategies. Test-time routing of a datapoint to one of the K cluster TMs is not described (Sec. 6.1 says 'each datapoint only requires one smaller independent Tsetlin Machine for training and inference'), so the pre-sorted accuracies may use cluster/class information unavailable at test time. EMNIST variant and class count, dataset sizes, binarization threshold X, T and s are not stated. Pre-sorted training time is identical for EMNIST and MNIST (15.58 s) as printed. Pre-sorted epochs: at most 100 under strategy 1, fewer (e.g. 4-6) under strategy 2; left not_reported. Paper's TM description (Sec. 2.1) uses N for the total number of states (N=6 example split into two regions), but no N is given for the experiments.
